release_notes:
ReadySetPDF 4.0.11

Assets can select several pages with Ctrl and Shift, and drag them into a new order. A moved page keeps its original number in parentheses. Each row shows the page size and whether it is color or black and white.

Page controls highlight All, Odd / Front, Even / Back, or a size. Rotate, resize, blank, and delete apply to every highlighted page. Right-click a PDF for a single-sided or double-sided job. A single-sided job puts a blank back after every page. A double-sided job keeps front and back pairs, and adds a blank only when the file ends on a front.

Arrange uses that same page list, so a change there shows up in Assets.

The monitor fits the page to the pane. View is 1 page or 2 columns. Each page has rulers, and a dotted line marks the trim when the page has bleed. The wheel and the scrollbar move through every asset, and the asset list follows.

Tool buttons start collapsed so the form has room. Scrolling a tool stays inside the Tools pane.

Export Proofs opens Folds. Export the proof as PDF, PNG, or JPG.

The steps stack starts open as a short strip under the preview. Drag its top edge to make it taller.
